chunks: Ibn Bukayr narrated from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, and Jamīl narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
That they asked them about the mutamattiʿ who brings forward his tawāf and his saʿy in the hajj, and they said: “They are the same, whether you perform them earlier or later.”

key_terms.سَعْيَهُ: his saʿy, the ritual walking between Ṣafā and Marwah
key_terms.سِيَّانِ: equal in ruling; the same either way

ai.seo_question: Can a pilgrim performing hajj al-tamattuʿ do the tawaf and saʿy earlier or later?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the pilgrim performing hajj al-tamattuʿ. It states that advancing or delaying the tawaf and saʿy of hajj is treated the same in this case, indicating permissibility in the order mentioned.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2779 - Ibn Bukayr narrated from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (as), and Jamil narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), that they were asked about a person performing tamattu‘ who performs their tawaf and sa‘i for Hajj earlier than usual.
They (as) said: "It is the same, whether you perform them earlier or later."
